name: Mt Piper 500 kV Line Trips
summary: During the Black Summer bushfires, multiple 500 kV transmission lines between Mt Piper and Bayswater tripped due to bushfire smoke ionisation and conductor clash. Mt Piper Unit 1 also tripped offline.
source: AEMO Power System Operating Incident Report

timeline.event: Bushfire activity intensifies near Mt Piper - Bayswater corridor
Mount Piper to Bayswater 5A3 line trips due to smoke ionisation
Mount Piper to Bayswater 5A5 line trips
Mt Piper Unit 1 trips offline due to protection operation
Load shedding constraints activated for central-west NSW
5A3 line returned to service following line patrol
5A5 line returned to service, system restored to normal

constraints.description: Network support constraint for Mt Piper - Bayswater 5A3 outage (estimated ID based on AEMO naming conventions)
Network support constraint for Mt Piper - Bayswater 5A5 outage (estimated ID based on AEMO naming conventions)

constraintNote: Constraint IDs are estimated based on AEMO constraint set naming conventions. Actual MMSDM GENCONSETINVOKE/DISPATCHCONSTRAINT data for December 2019 should be verified for exact constraint set IDs.
notes: This incident was part of the widespread bushfire impacts across NSW during the 2019-2020 Black Summer. The 500 kV lines between Mt Piper and Bayswater form a critical transmission path for power from the western coal-fired generators.
